title: Nullspawn
description: A server just like 2b2t but smaller
body: Nullspawn is a pure anarchy Minecraft server with no claims, no rules, and no protections. Everything is allowed — building, griefing, PvP, and chaos are all part of the experience. The world is permanent and constantly shaped by players, meaning nothing is safe and nothing lasts forever. Spawn in, survive however you can, and decide what kind of mark you want to leave on the world.
